synergies.name: Troll
synergies.tooltip:
SPECIES TRAIT: Voodoo Frenzy
Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this species on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Trolls: Increases the attack speed of all allies by 20.
(4) Trolls: Increases the attack speed of all allies by 50.
(6) Trolls: All allies gain +20 attack speed for each successful attack. Maximum 7 stacks.
synergies.lore: Savage trolls are notorious for their cruelty, dark occult religion, and fierce hatred of other races.

synergies.name: Beast
synergies.tooltip:
Species Trait: Power of the Wild
Active when you have at least (N) different Beast pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Beasts: All allies have +10% attack damage, including summoned units.
(4) Beasts: All allies have +25% attack damage, including summoned units.
(6) Beasts: Attacks from all allies increase physical damage taken by the target by 10%. This effect stacks up to a maximum of 10 and can be applied by friendly summoned units.
synergies.lore: Beasts have superhuman strength, stamina and speed, and are good at group predation.

synergies.name: Elf
synergies.tooltip:
Species Trait: Evasion
Active when you have at least (N) different Elf pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(3) Elves: All friendly elves have +25% evasion.
(6) Elves: All friendly elves have +40% evasion.
(9) Elves: Friendly elves gain the effect: Dodging any attack will conceal itself for 1 second and create a mirrored attack from the attacker, targeting the enemy.
synergies.lore: Nimble Elves who live on the crown of the World Tree are one of the most important primal protectors of Drodo Island. Their belief in the Goddess of the Moon and natural harmony has profoundly affected their lifestyle.

synergies.name: Human
synergies.tooltip:
Species Perk: Spark of Mind
Active when you have at least (N) different human pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(3) Humans: Gain 2 experience points at the start of each round.
(6) Humans: Gain (Courier Level - 2) points of experience points at the start of each round if you won your last home battle.
synergies.lore: Humans are an intelligent species that values kindness and cooperation, and silences any who they deem unworthy.

synergies.name: Undead
synergies.tooltip:
Species Trait: Plague
Active when you have at least (N) different Undead pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(3) Undeads: All non-undead pieces of both sides in the battle gain the plague effect: maximum health -10%.
(6) Undeads: All non-undead pieces of both sides in the battle gain the plague effect: maximum health -30%.
(9) Undeads: All plague-infected pieces lose 5% max health per 2.5 secs (no less than 5%).
synergies.lore: Many humans had unfortunately lost their life to the Scourge King during his conquest of his homeland. The victims were raised as Undeads with cruelty, turned into minions of the fleshless legion, and were forced to destroy their own kingdom under the command of the Fallen Prince.

synergies.name: Orc
synergies.tooltip:
SPECIES TRAIT: Battle Hardened
Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this species on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Orcs: All allies have +100 Health.
(4) Orcs: All allies have +400 Health.
(6) Orcs: All allies have +10x(Courier health lost) Health.
synergies.lore: The Orcs are a prolific and physically powerful race, excellent at tolerating pain and injury. Being exotic to Drodolands, their home was a once-lush world but now a shattered realm. They abandoned their peaceful culture when the demon lord cunningly corrupted the Orcs and used them in his vengeful plot against the his own people.

synergies.name: Naga
synergies.tooltip:
Species Trait: Scale Armor
Active when you have at least (N) different Naga pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Naga: Grants allies 15% magic resistance.
(4) Naga: Grants allies 35% magic resistance.
(6) Naga: When taking non-pure damage, reflect 1.5 times the magical resistance.
synergies.lore: Nagas are cursed sea-dwellers that haunt the ocean floor. Their hardened, scaly skin acts as an effective defense against spells.

synergies.name: Goblin
synergies.tooltip:
Species Perk: Nanobots
Active when you have at least (N) different goblin pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(3)Goblins: Grants a random melee ally +10 armour and +20 health regeneration.
(6)Goblins: Grants all allies+10 armor and +20 health regeneration.
synergies.lore: Goblins are a cunning species with a love for money, explosives, and less-than-reliable technology. Their drive to invent fuels them, giving the brightest among them a boost in stamina and fortitude.

synergies.name: Elemental
synergies.tooltip:
Elemental Essence
Active when you have at least (N) different Element pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Elements: All friendly elementals have +15% chance to turn melee aggressors into stone for 3 sec.
(4) Elements: All allies have +15% chance to turn melee and ranged aggressors into stone for 4 sec.
(6) Elements: Aggressors are stoned for 1 sec longer and take +100% damage.
synergies.lore: Elementals are unstable beings that radiate mysterious energy when attacked. This gives them a chance to turn their melee aggressors to stone.

synergies.name: Demon
synergies.tooltip:
SPECIES TRAIT: Fel Power
Active when you control only 1 type of Demon on the chessboard.

(1) Demon: Normal attack damage caused by allied demon chess pieces is settled as pure damage. Fel Powers damage is increased by 15%,with a maximum stack count of 7.
synergies.lore: Chaotic beings that emerged from a dimensional fissure.

synergies.name: Dwarf
synergies.tooltip:
Species Trait: Take Aim
Active when you have at least (N) different Dwarf pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Dwarves: All dwarves’ attack range +200, physical damage deals 15% increased damage for every 1 square away from the target.
synergies.lore: Dwarves are a bold and courageous species of humanoids that excel in creating and refining weapons and gadgets, allowing them to slay their foes from afar.

synergies.name: Ogre
synergies.tooltip:
SPECIES TRAIT: Iron Fist
Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this species on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Ogres: Each ogre can eat up allies nearby (A cross of 4 grids) whose level is lower than itself and gains their 60% HP and Damage. Deals extra damage to enemys courier equals to the sum of all its victims when winning an away-home battle.
synergies.lore: Ogres have two heads, or was it three? More heads, more stamina!

synergies.name: Dragon
synergies.tooltip:
Species Trait: Attunement
Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this species on board. (Multiple effects stack).

(3) Dragons: All friendly Dragons have an initial mana value of 100.
(5) Dragons: All allies have an initial mana value of 100.
synergies.lore: Dragons were among the first creatures to exist on this ancient land. They possess unimaginable powers, deep within, which they like to show off when they commune together.

synergies.name: Satyr
synergies.tooltip:
SPECIES TRAIT: Fear
Active when you have at least (N) different pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack.)

(2) Satyr: Allied Satyr chess pieces gain the effect: If there is more than 1 enemy nearby, they cause those enemies to lose control due to fear.
synergies.lore: Demonic species rose from twisted elves, experts at concealing themselves in nightmares, and fanatics in spreading blood and agony.

synergies.name: God
synergies.tooltip:
SPECIES TRAIT: Overweening superiority
Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this species on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2)Gods: All allies get the effect: skill cooldown time -40%.
(4)Gods: All allies get the effect: skill cooldown time -40%.
(6) Gods: All allies get the effect: Using skills that consume mana will reduce the current remaining cooldown time of active abilities and items by 60%.
synergies.lore: The highly worshipped Gods are considered as the creators of Drodo Island. Being both arrogant and prideful, the loyal beliefs from their creations have forged the supreme powers that Gods possess, granting them the most significant potential among all creatures which can completely change the outcome of a battle.

synergies.name: Aqir
synergies.tooltip:
Species Trait: Infection
Active when there are at least (N) different Aqir chess pieces on the chessboard. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Aqirs: Grants all non-Aqir allies: Upon death, if there is any Infected friendly piece of the same name on the chessboard, immediately hatches a random Aqir piece.
(4) Aqirs: Rank 1 effect now also applies to all friendly Aqir pieces , and will hatch a random higher-level Aqir piece.
synergies.lore: From time to time, the Aqirs dwelled on and beneath the ancient land of Drodo Island. Though most of their powers are sealed by the holy Gods, remained powers from the insanity within the Aqir blood draws their insectoid instinct to reside on the flesh of other creatures.

synergies.name: Pandaren
synergies.tooltip:
SPECIES TRAIT: Hospitality
Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this species on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(1) Pandaren: Have a chance to invite a random un-emerged chess piece of the same species with a chess piece on the board from the chess piece pool to join the team at the beginning of the round.
(2) Pandaren: Each Pandaren chess piece on board has a chance to invite a piece of the same name with it.
synergies.lore: Ten thousand years ago the last emperor of the Pandaren Empire surrounded his entire territory in the misty protection in order to save his people from the Great Havoc. Now the ancient species has once again revealed themselves and they are literally a mist to the others.

synergies.name: Tauren
synergies.tooltip:
SPECIES TRAIT: Totem of the Clan
Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this species on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Taurens: Summons a Taunt Totem at the start of the battle.
(4) Taurens: Summons a Woodpecker Totem and a Horn Totem at the start of the battle.
synergies.lore: Peace-loving Taurens live on mountain-high plateaus of the barren Drodoland. They strive to preserve the balance of nature at the behest of the Earth Mother.

synergies.name: Kobold
synergies.tooltip:
SPECIES TRAIT: Divided we stand
Active when you have at least (N) different Kobold pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Kobolds: Each two paired ally pieces on board will summon a replica when battle starts.
(4) Kobolds: Every unpaired Kobold piece will reshape itself into a non-Kobold ally of the same rank before battle starts.
synergies.lore: Aggressive, xenophobic, yet industrious small humanoid creatures living in tunnels and caves deep below the surface. Known for not particularly intelligent, notoriously cowardly and individually weak, the dimunitive beings possess great potential in group combats. A candle on top of the head distinguishes the Kobolds.

synergies.name: Faceless
synergies.tooltip:
Species Trait: Whisper of Darkness
Active when you have at least (N) different Faceless pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Facelesses: If you have no other active synergies except Whisper of Darkness, all friendly chess pieces are immune to all negative effects during combat.
synergies.lore: The Faceless, otherwise known as the Faceless Ones or N'raqi, are a monstrous race that arose from the organic matter that seeped from the Old Gods' blighted forms during the primordial era of Drodo Island. Cunning and intelligent, they serve their eldritch masters with fanatical loyalty and possess the power from the Void.

synergies.name: Draenei
synergies.tooltip:
SPECIES TRAIT: Blessing of the Naaru
Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this species on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Draeneis: All friendly Draenei gain the effect: Every 4 seconds, steal 50+2% max health from the nearest enemy chess piece to heal themselves.
(4) Draeneis: All friendly pieces gain effects: Whenever a cumulative total of more than 100 points of healing is taken it is split (cumulative healing) points of pure damage among the surrounding enemies.
synergies.lore: To evade the Burning Legions clutches, a congregation led by the Farseer fled their homelands, faithful to the Naaru and the Holy Light. They named themselves Draenei, the Exiled Ones.

synergies.name: Centaur
synergies.tooltip:
SPECIES TRAIT: Stampede
Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this species on board. (Multiple effects stack).

(2)Centaurs: All friendly Centaurs gain the effect: when starting a battle, immediately charge to the target grid with the most enemy pieces around, and stun the enemy pieces on the path.
(4)Centaurs: Every move of all melee-friendly pieces is a Stampede.
synergies.lore: Centaurs are a half-humanoid, half-beast, war-like tribal race. Being born from the conceiving of the Demi-gods son and the earth elemental, the race shows an extreme aggressiveness towards other tribes.

synergies.name: Harpy
synergies.tooltip:
Species Trait: Windfury
Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this species on board. (Multiple effects stack).

(2) Harpies: All allies gain the effect - Targeted spells +1 additional targets.
(4) Harpies: All allies gain the effect - Targeted spells +1 additional targets.
synergies.lore: Harpies believe they survived from an ancient age. Their ancestors are transformed into bird-like bodies after betraying the Night Elves Queen.

synergies.name: Warrior
synergies.tooltip:
Warriors have a double bonus from Fortified Armor while below 50% health.

Class Perk: Fortified Armor
Active when you have at least (N) different Warrior pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(3) Warriors: All friendly warriors have +3 armour.
(6) Warriors: All friendly warriors have +12 armour.
(9) Warriors: Reflect pure damage equivalent to (1.5x current armour) when taking physical and magical damage.

synergies.name: Mage
synergies.tooltip:
For every standing friendly Mage on the chessboard, Mage pieces receive +10% bonus mana restoration, up to a maximum of 60%.

Class Perk: Magical Vulnerability
Active when you have at least (N) different mage pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(3) Mages: All enemies suffer -30% magic resistance.
(6) Mages: All enemies suffer -35% magic resistance.
(9) Mages: All enemies are cursed with frost incantation, which freezes them upon receiving magical damage. Lasts longer for more increased damage taken.
synergies.lore: Mages are keen intellectuals who have spent years studying arcane knowledge. This allows them to make their victims more vulnerable to magic damage.

synergies.name: Warlock
synergies.tooltip:
Warlock pieces convert 25% of their health into 50% mana when a battle starts.

Class Perk: Soul Leech
Active when you have at least (N) different Warlock pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Warlocks: All allies have All allies have +5% lifesteal from all damage dealt.
(4) Warlocks: All allies have All allies have +20% lifesteal from all damage dealt.
(6) Warlocks: All ally warlocks steal a max health of 0.5x damage on every attack.
synergies.lore: Warlocks are cursed sorcerers who use demonic power to drain the life force from their enemies, restoring themselves to continue their cursed battle.

synergies.name: Mech
synergies.tooltip:
Inventors arm themselves with the latest technology that allows them to receive +50% healing from other sources.

Class Perk: Heart of the Machine
Active when you have at least (N) different Inventor pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(3) Inventors: Summon an AWESOME Invention after winning a home battle last round with at least 1 friendly Inventor who survived.
(6) Inventors: Heart of the Machine now summons a Golden AWESOME Invention.
synergies.lore: Inventors are usually the ones within a race who possess the most profound knowledge, and the are ambitious in discover new methods and creations. Though most of the time the inventions are problematic and not-so-reliable, they do invoke miracles sometimes.

synergies.name: Assassin
synergies.tooltip:
The first movement of Assassin pieces in each round causes Assassins to leap over to the back of the enemy lineup. The first blow after Backstab Leap is always a critical strike with a random bonus damage amplifier.

Class Perk: Coup de Grace
Active when you have at least (N) different Assassin pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(3) Assassins: All friendly assassins have 15% chance to critical hit for 250% damage.
(6) Assassins: All assassins have 15% chance to critical hit for 400% damage.
(9) Assassins: All assassins refresh a Backstab Leap move after killing an enemy or a certain duration. This Backstab Leap always deals the maximum possible critical damage.
synergies.lore: Assassins are skilled executioners that leap into enemy backlines. Together, they gain a keen eye for weaknesses in enemy armor, gaining the ability to deliver devastating critical hits.

synergies.name: Hunter
synergies.tooltip:
Hunter pieces always focus on attacking the lowest health enemy within attack range.

Class Perk: Aimed Shot
Active when you have at least (N) different Hunter pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(3) Hunters: Every attack of all ally hunters has a 50% chance to perform a precise shot, penetrates evasion and -5 armor, lasts for 5 seconds.
(6) Hunters: Every attack of all ally hunters has a 80% chance to perform a precise shot, penetrates evasion and -8 armor, lasts for 8 seconds.
(9) Hunters: Every precise shot will knock back the victim for 1 grid on hit and perform an extra attack.
synergies.lore: Since time immemorial, the call of the wild has driven some adventurers from the comfort of their home to venture into unforgiving primeval worlds. Those who persist become hunters.

synergies.name: Knight
synergies.tooltip:
Knight pieces who have nearby allies will gain a Divine Protection shield immediately.

Class Perk: Divine Protection
Active when you have at least (N) different Knight pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Knights: All friendly knights have a 25% chance to procure a shield every 3 seconds in combat for 3 seconds.
(4) Knights: All allies have a +25% chance to procure a shield every 3 seconds in combat.
(6) Knights: All allies have a +25% chance to procure a shield every 3 seconds in combat. Procing a shield instantly heals for 500.
synergies.lore: Knights are respected defenders of the realm. As they engage in battle, the Omniscience may bless them with a divine shield.

synergies.name: Shaman
synergies.tooltip:
Shaman pieces spend 25% less mana when casting spells.

Class Perk: Hex
Active when you have at least (N) different Shaman pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(3)All friendly Shaman chess pieces gain the effect: Transform into a random chess piece of +2 levels after casting an active skill or using an active item.
(6)Shaman: Equipped items carried by transformed chess pieces will also transform into random items of +2 levels.
synergies.lore: Mortal mediators of the ancient elements. Following the guide of ancestral spirits, Shaman learn to wield unseemingly mysterious power over generations to protect their family and clans.

synergies.name: Demon Hunter
synergies.tooltip:
Counts as a different enemy Demon type.

CLASS PERK: Shuttered Soul
Active when you have at least (N) different Demon Hunter pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)
(2) Demon Hunters: All friendly demons are considered the same type.
(4) Demon Hunters: All damage dealt is settled as Pure Damage.
synergies.lore: Demon hunters ritually trade their normal form in exchange for the mastery of demonic powers that enables them to deliver devastating strikes to their prey. This enhanced strength, together with their great agility and magical prowess, makes demon hunters unsuppressible.

synergies.name: Priest
synergies.tooltip:
Priest Pieces are determined, and cannot be mind controlled.
Class Perk: Salvation
Active when you have at least (N) different Priest pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Priests: Get a Tango when defeated in a home battle with courier health lost if your pieces on board are less than your max pieces capacity.
(4) Priest: Every Priest piece will Mind Control an enemy whose level equals to or less than itself if your pieces on board are less than your max pieces capacity. (Max control count = Your capacity - Your pieces on board)
synergies.lore: Priests are blessed invokers of light and darkness, who express their determined spirits through dedicated service to the people. For numerous battles, with the mastery of light and shadow energies they have weaved the most reliable life-saving protections for their allies.

synergies.name: Wizard
synergies.tooltip:
Wizard chess pieces are never considered priority targets by enemies.

Class Perk: Something from Nothing
Active when you have at least (N) different Wizard pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Wizards: During the combat round, reduce the required number of chess pieces for the activation of race/class skills by 1, if there are (4) or more chess pieces needed.
(4) Wizards: If you trigger the unique non-Wizard race/class skill during the combat round, unlock all of its layers.
synergies.lore: Wizards play an ancient yet mysterious role. Even though they mostly comprehend oracles and do minor entertaining tricks, Wizards are regarded as evil by many others because of the uncertainty of their purpose of action. The unique power Wizards possess awakes the inner potential of others, leading to a more united alliance.

synergies.name: Monk
synergies.lore: When the Pandaren were subjugated centuries ago, it was the monks that brought hope to a seemingly dim future. Restricted from using weapons by their slave masters, these Pandaren instead focused on harnessing their physical ability and learning weaponless combat. When the opportunity for revolution struck, they were well-trained to throw off the yoke of oppression.

synergies.name: Druid
synergies.tooltip:
Druid pieces will not be destroyed on a ★★★ piece combined.

CLASS PERK: Synergy
Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this class on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Druids: Two identical Druid★ can promote to a Druid★★.
(4) Druids: Two identical Druid★★ can promote to a Druid★★★.
(6) Druids: Two identical Druid★★★ can promote to the great Altar of Spirits♥♥♥, and gain several(equal to the level of Druid★★★) stack of Altar Power, and destroy all Druid pieces in the chess pool.
synergies.lore: Druids can control great power of Nature to protect spirits and balance.

skill.name: Aphotic Shield
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Summons dark energies around a most-damaged ally unit, creating a shield that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the shield is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount absorbed to an area of 3-grid radius around it.
skill.lore: The powers of the black mist rise to absorb attacks like the black mist absorbs light.

skill.name: Chilling Touch
skill.header: Passiave Ability
skill.description: Grant Ancient Apparition attack speed bonus and trap its target in chilling frost with attack speed decreased and health recharge prevented.
skill.lore: The ancient apparition’s eternal knowledge brings a frigid enchantment to his attacks.

skill.name: Berserker's Call
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Axe taunts enemies within 1 grid, forcing them to attack him, while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
skill.lore: Mogul Khans warcry taunts opponents into engaging in an unconquerable battle with the Axe.

skill.name: Fiend's Grip
skill.header: Active Skill: Activates at Full Mana
skill.description: Channeling Spell: Grabs a random enemy chess piece, rendering it unable to act and dealing pure damage.
skill.lore: Victims of Atropos often suffer excruciating agony from the vivid illusions in their nightmares.

skill.name: Jinada Toss
skill.header: Targeted Passive Ability
skill.description:
Gets a bag of gold when killing an enemy for the first time

Active ability: Activates at Full Mana
throws a deadly dart at the enemy chess piece with the lowest health, dealing magical damageand a brief Stun.
skill.lore: Bounty hunter never comes back with empty hands
notes: One piece can get a single bag only, and refresh its chance to get when upgraded

skill.name: Cinder Brew
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Drenches an area in alcohol, causing enemy chess pieces within the area to lose some of their attacks. Taking spell damage causes affected enemies to ignite and extends the duration of igition on the enemies.
skill.lore: The Order of the Oyos solution to all problems - another round!

skill.name: Burning Barrage
skill.header: Active ability: Activate on Full Mana
skill.description: Clinkz shoots multiple burning arrows that hit all enemies in a line. Every shot deals his attack physical damage.
skill.lore: Its hard to say whether the blur around the Bone Fletcher is from his flaming heart or his speed with the quiver.

skill.name: Battery Assault
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy chess pieces within 2 grids, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
skill.lore: Some of Rattletraps contraptions don't quite work correctly, so detonating them proves useful as an offensive maneuver.

skill.name: Arcane Aura
skill.header: Aura:
skill.description: Grants periodic mana regeneration for all allied chess pieces.
skill.lore: Cold temperatures promote the essence of magic, causing Rylais presence to allow spell usage in abundance.

values.label: Grants additional mana regeneration every 2 seconds

skill.name: Bramble Maze
skill.header: Battle Cry Ability: Activates before the battle starts
skill.description: Creates a bramble maze to isolate random enemies from battle, victims cannot attack or be attacked until the maze disappears.
skill.lore: The fae realm exists all around you, merely waiting to draw you in…

skill.name: Shallow Grave
skill.description: Bless allied pieces with Shallow Grave, preventing the targets from dying while under its protection, no matter how close to death. The blessed ally takes +50% healing from all sources for the duration.
skill.lore: Only a seasoned acolyte of the Shadow can properly perform the rite of preventing death.
notes: Shallow grave will first be given to allies hp lower than 50%.

skill.name: Untouchable
skill.header: Aura:
skill.description: Granting allies nearby to slow enemy attacks when attacked.
skill.lore: After attacking Aiuthsha, most opponents are overwhelmed with guilt having attacked such a nature beauty.

skill.name: Acorn Shot
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates instantly
skill.description: Hoodwink attacked with an acorn at the target unit. The acorn bounces to nearby targets, bouncing it to several nearby threatening enemy chess pieces, dealing physical damage, and granting a 100% chance for probable effects of all allies’ synergy on its victims.
skill.lore: Though she will make do with almost anything, Oak and Ironwood acorns make the most effective projectiles -- and the bulk of Hoodwinks stash.
notes: Not stackable.

skill.name: Bulwark
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
Whenever Mars is attacked from the front or sides, he swings his massive shield to block a certain percentage of the damage.

Active ability: Activates upon completing cooldown.
At regular intervals, Mars raises his shield to unleash Gods Rebuke, pushing back enemy chess pieces within 3 grids in front of him and dealing physical damage.
skill.lore: Only the very foolish dare to fight fair with the god of war.

skill.name: Sacred Arrow
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision to an enemy chess in another chessboard currently under attack/defense from friendly chess pieces, dealing damage and stun to the target. Damage and stun duration increase with range.
skill.lore: Lunar energies make the Princess of the Moons arrows more deadly than most.

skill.name: Disseminate
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Instant Activation>
skill.description: Applying the toxic curse of Shadow Demons attacks: Nearby allies will receive damage of the same type as a percentage when taking damage, and nearby enemies will also receive healing as a percentage when receiving healing.
skill.lore: When the Eredar no longer requires his followers, he will discard his shackles—along with their lives.
notes: The spreading effect cannot be stacked on the same unit.

skill.name: Croak!
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Transform an enemy into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks, abilities and items.
skill.lore: Rhasta often ended performances by turning himself into a frog - now, the humiliation is shared.

skill.name: Arcane Bolt
skill.header: Targeted active ability: Activate on ally skill cast
skill.description: Whenever an allied piece casts a skill, the Stormrage Mage will immediately cast a slow-moving Arcane Bolt swarm at the enemy, dealing magic damage to the target.
skill.lore: Within the Ghastly Eyries endless intrigue, only the clever and the calm can hope to survive.

skill.name: Greater Bash
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description: Attacks have a chance to stun and knockback the enemy and deal bonus damage.
skill.lore: The signature strike of Barathrums ghostly ball and chain.

skill.name: Heat Seeking Missile
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Launches 3/4 rockets to strike random enemy chess pieces.
skill.lore: The last contraption Boush was able to save was a retrofitted rocket launcher with a homing mechanism.

skill.name: Walrus PUNCH!
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike so powerful it launches a nearby enemy within 1 grid into the air.
skill.lore: It never matters who throws the first punch, only who throws the last.

skill.name: Cold Embrace
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
skill.lore: From winters heart comes to a cold, healing embrace. The ice slows the blood and allows the spell to better work its curative magic.

skill.name: Paralyzing Cask
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy chess pieces, stunning and damaging those it hits.
skill.lore: The Witch Doctor recycles the bones of fallen friends and foes, using the powder as part of his arsenal of charms and alchemy.

skill.name: Firefly
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Batrider flis towards the farthest cell which allows him to attack an enemy, laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches, causing damage over time.
skill.lore: When an enemy escapes into the Yama Raskav Jungle, most would cut through the brush to find the fugitive. Batrider just chooses to destroy the jungle along with his foes.

skill.name: Call of the Wild
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description:
Beastmaster summons his powerful companions to aid in the battlefield.
Level 1: Summons a Boar.
Level 2: Summons a Hawk.
Level 3: Summons a Battle Bear with Taunt ability.
skill.lore: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.

skill.name: Blood Rite
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Bloodseeker baptizes an area centred at himself in sacred blood. After the ritual completes, any enemies caught in the area takePure Damage, and becomesilenced.
skill.lore: The Flayed Twins are ever willing to aid those who spill blood upon the field of battle.

skill.name: Double Edge
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates instant
skill.description: Centaur Warrunner strikes a mighty blow at melee range, dealing damage due to a percentage of his Max HP to himself and a small area around the target.
skill.lore: In the spurs of combat, Bradwarden’s vicious strikes sometimes cause self-inflicted collateral damage.

skill.name: Chaos Strike
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description: Chaos Knights attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength, in addition to a lifesteal for percentage of the damage.
skill.lore: Chaos Knight’s unwieldy power bludgeons those who stand before him, crushing the thickest of armors.

skill.name: Ion Shell
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Surrounds a friendly piece in a bristling shield, causing it to take less damage and deal continuous damage to surrounding enemiesmagic damage.

skill.name: Time Zone
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: .Creates a blister in spacetime, altering the movement, attack speed of all units inside. Allies have increased speed and enemies have decreased speed
skill.lore: Enemies are leashed inside the Time Zone.

skill.name: Nature's Call
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description:
Call treants from random trees surrounding the chessboard to battle for Natures Prophet.
Level 1: Summons 1 Treant.
Level 2: Summons 2 Treants.
Level 3: Summons 2 Greater Treants.
skill.lore: Verodicia bestowed the Prophet with the ability to summon the Treant Guard, a mythical sentient army of the wild.

skill.name: Stroke of Fate
skill.header: BATTLECRY ABILITY: Activates on battle
skill.description: Grimstroke paints an ink trail, reducing the attack speed and mana regeneration of enemies on hit.
skill.lore: The corruptive force of Grimstrokes ink, drawn from the reservoir of his fallen people, consumes any enemy caught in its path.

skill.name: Blade Fury
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description:
Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, dealing damage to nearby enemies within 2 grids.magical damage.
During the spin the Juggernaut gets 80% Magical Resistance.As Juggernauts attack speed increases, the interval between the damages of Blade Fury decreases.
skill.lore: Yurneros renowned katana techniques are feared by warriors and sorcerers alike.

skill.name: Frogstomp
skill.description: Largo tosses froglings to an area, they stomps the ground every 1 second, dealing damage and ministuns, enemies in the area have reduced speed.
skill.lore: Most bardmonks spend decades mastering the musical art, but even the top frog Largo has to admit that his young disciples have already grown shockingly good at counting a proper beat.

skill.name: Rage
skill.header: Active ability: Activates instant
skill.description: Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune and Pure damage Immune and increasing magic resistance.
skill.lore: The madness and brutality of N'aix makes him a vicious and unrelenting foe in combat.

skill.name: Laguna Blade
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive magical damageandMagic damage.
skill.lore: The air around Lina becomes so intensely torrid that it scorches a foe that came too close with white-hot lightning.

skill.name: Moon Glaives
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description: Strengthens Lunas Moon Glaive, allowing her attacks to bounce among enemy chess pieces. Each bounce reduces the damage dealt.
skill.lore: Carefully sharpened, Lunas boomerang-like weapon cuts a wide swath through enemy numbers.

skill.name: Poof
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
When Meepo is upgraded to ★★★, one will be copied.

Active ability: Activate when full mana
By drawing mysterious energy from the earth, all Meepo can be teleported from the underground to the location of the designated enemy. Each Meepo will attack nearby areas in the area it reaches. Enemies deal pure damage.
skill.lore: Sometimes breaking one of the Riftshadow Crystals can be just the trick for getting yourself out of a bind. Or your other self.

skill.name: Pierce the veil
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
When Muerta attacks, she has a chance to shoot another target.

Active ability: Activate when full mana
Muerta enters the void form, immune to all physical damage, and gains attack power bonus And all her attack damage is magical damage.
skill.lore: Muerta sheds her corporeal form, crossing the spirit veil and striking her enemies with the fury of the damned.

skill.name: Rain of Destiny
skill.header: Active Ability: Activate on full mana
skill.description: Bring forth rain to the target area and heal allies in.
skill.lore: Through a mixture of the astral and atmospheric Nerif bends a single reality into a paradoxical alignment.
notes: Lucky Aura: Have additional chances on all probability synergies.

skill.name: Essence Shift
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description: Slark steals the attack speed of enemy pieces with his attacks.
skill.lore: With each strike at his adversaries, Slarks knowledge of their weaknesses improves.

skill.name: Assassinate
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activate on full mana
skill.description: Sniper locks onto a target enemy chess piece and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals massive physical damage at long range.
skill.lore: To fulfill the prophecy and return to his hometown, Kardel must make another shot as perfect as the one on the day of his ancient test.

skill.name: Whirling Death
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies within 2 grids.
skill.lore: In the case that Rizzrack gets surrounded by the vines and plants of nightmares, he has an immediate chainsaw defense.

skill.name: Toss
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
Gains 100 max health permanently if killed in a home battle.

Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
Grabs a nearby enemy, and launches it at the farthest enemy 3 squares away from the victim, or directly up into the air, to deal damage and stun where they land.
skill.lore: Tinys gargantuan stature allows him to catapult even the sturdiest of warriors.

skill.name: Nether Swap
skill.header: Targeted active ability: Instant
skill.description: Swap positions with one or more enemy chess pieces whose star level is no higher than(Nether Swap skill level)
skill.lore: Martyrdom is a small price to pay for vengeance.
notes: Nether Swap cannot target a unit with a higher level.

If there are no enemy pieces of equal level, a target lower than this level will be selected; If there are multiple enemy pieces of the same level, Vengeful Spirit will tend to choose a target with lower health.

skill.name: Shackleshot
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Bind the target enemy chess piece to the enemy chess piece or tree directly behind it, causing them to bestunned.
skill.lore: Windranger’s variety of bow skills includes an arrow with thick ropes attached to encumber any escaping target.
notes: Shackleshot can bind target and its ally behind.

skill.name: Fire wreath
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attackphysical damage.On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.Stunning.
skill.lore: Across the vast lineage of star progeny, there were multitudes unwilling to align with the aims of the Children of Light. To those who dared organise defiance, the Children would dispatch Valora and her hammer to show a measure of their power--to leave the rebels either shattered or set back to rights.

skill.name: Gust
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back enemy pieces with magical damage dealt.
skill.lore: Traxex is rather fond of the tranquility of magical combat, calling on her drow heritage to end the incantations of opposing magi.

skill.name: Fissure
skill.description: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone. Enemy chess pieces along the line are stunned and knocked to the nearest vacant squares, and suffer physical damage.
skill.lore: The Nishian totem splits the world to its core with tectonic force.

skill.name: Midnight Pulse
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Steeps an area of 3-square radius in dark resonance, damaging enemy chess pieces within based on their maximum health.
skill.lore: A section of the world slowly descends into the void.

skill.name: Berserker's Blood
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
Huskar ignites his spear with boiling blood. Each normal attack will cause magical damage to himself, while also causing stackable continuous damage to enemy pieces.
Based on the percentage of Huskars missing health, he will gain attack speed, magic resistance, and percentage health regeneration bonuses.
skill.lore: The Sacred Warrior ignites his weaponry after marking it with his blood - causing far greater pain than he feels.

values.label: BONUS ATTACK SPEED PER 10% HEALTH LOST
BONUS MAGIC RESISTANCE PER 10% HEALTH LOST
BONUS HEALTH REGEN PER 10% HEALTH LOST

skill.name: Kazurai Katana
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Kez attacks with his Kanata, stuns the victim and deals Physical Damage equals to a percentage of the victim's Max Health. Stab forward and back each deals half the damage and affiliates his base attack damage.
skill.lore: To fight back against the reach of Imperia and her Queensguard, the Kazurai had to become skilled in the ways of attrition.

skill.name: Press the Attack
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
After being attacked, the legion commander has a chance to immediately carry out a counterattack, with a blood-sucking effect.
If the legion commander wins the home battle and survives, the piece will gain a permanent effect: Increased attack power.
skill.lore: The rallying horn of the Bronze Legion can inspire any heart.
notes: Press The Attack also grants bonus damage by winning Loot Rounds.
When promoted to higher ranks, Legion Commander inherits the highest Press The Attack bonus damage stacks from the minor pieces.

skill.name: Shapeshift
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him bonus health and healing himself for the same amount. Meanwhile summons multiple wolves in nearby vacant grids to battle for Lycan.
skill.lore: Forever a slave to his lycanthropy, Banehallow has come to accept his curse, and embrace his savagery.

skill.name: Unleash
skill.header: Active ability: Activate on full mana
skill.description: Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse for magical damage around the target that slows movement and attack speed of the victims.
skill.lore: Though some have sought to understand its origins, Marci rebuffs all attempts to divine the source of her power.

skill.name: Song of the Siren
skill.header: Active: Activate on full mana
skill.description: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren have a chance to be put into a sleep every 0.5 sec, where they cannot act or be attacked. Any non-ability damage will cause the victim to wake up.
skill.lore: Slithices powerful voice enchants leagues of opponents, while calling her Slithereen kin in a time of need.

skill.name: Multicast Aura
skill.header: Aura
skill.description: Grants all allies around: Have a chance to recast its ability and gain a bloodlust effect with bonus attack speed.
skill.lore: Despite being largely incapacitated by his IQ, the Ogre Magis success in battle is attributed to pure skill.

skill.name: Meat Hook
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates instantly
skill.description: Launches a bloody hook toward the farthest enemy, dragging it back to Pudge and dealing pure damage, and alias will prioritize attacking this target.
skill.lore: The Butchers hook is a symbolic nightmare, its curved blade a frightening reminder of his slaughterous intent.
notes: Channeling enemy will be interrupted upon hooked.
Hook can pass through other pieces.

skill.name: Plasma Field
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increase with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once in each direction.
skill.lore: The Lightning Revenant rules the Underscape with plasmatic power.

skill.name: Smoke Screen
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
Hides your position during the preparation phase.

Battlecry Ability: Activates before the battle starts
Immediately throws a smoke bomb. If there are enemy chess pieces nearby, the smoke bomb will be thrown at the position of the Riki; otherwise, it will be thrown at the symmetrical center point of the board relative to Riki. Enemies within the smoke are silenced and blinded(attacks have a chance to miss)
skill.lore: Since his escape during the night of his betrayal, Riki has valued the use of a simple smoke screen to confuse his opponents.

skill.name: Spell Steal
skill.header: BATTLECRY ABILITY: Activates on battle
skill.description:
Rubick studies the trace magical essence of the enemy piece, learning the secrets of the spell the piece has.
At the start of a combat, Rubick randomly steals the active ability and attack range of an enemy piece who has mana to replace Spell Steal.
Rubick on the chessboard resets his ability to Spell Steal when losing a home battle.
skill.lore: I am no thief. I merely borrow.
notes: Rubick can steal both active and passive spells, excluding class perks and species traits.
Rubick resets his ability to Spell Steal when combined into a higher level.

skill.name: Burrowstrike
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemies above him as he resurfaces.
skill.lore: Crixalis often lies in wait, burrowing under the surface to ambush his adversaries.

skill.name: Requiem of Souls
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description:
Shadow Fiend gathers captured souls and releases them in multiple streams of magical energy in all directions, dealingmagic damage.
In addition to the initial quantity, every 1 layer of demonic power will add an extra +1 shadow energy.
skill.lore: The captured souls of that past slain are released to ravage their former allies.
notes: Enemies may be damaged by multiple lines of energy if they are too close to Shadow Fiend.

skill.name: Slithereen Crush
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Slams the ground, deals physical damage and stun to nearby enemies. Victimcs are slowed afterwards.
skill.lore: A swift crush of might and water breaks even the toughest of defenses.

skill.name: Metamorphosis
skill.header: Active ability: Activate on Full Mana
skill.description: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demonic form with a ranged attack, removing most of the status effects from himself. Rank 2 or higher Terrorblade also transforms his nearest ally into a demon with a rank equal to the transformed chess piece(no higher than the rank of Terrorblade).
skill.lore: Temper, temper. The rage rises up and takes control. Meet Terrorblades own worst self.
notes: Demonic Terrorblade is in a rampage. Loses previous abilities and cannot use active items.
Demonic Terrorblade retains effects from passive item bonus and Fel Power.

skill.name: Leech Seed
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Plant a leech Seed in enemys body, decreases its attack and movement speed and takes magical damage to heal enemies around per second.
notes: Before cast on the higher level enemy

skill.name: Decay
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Undying steals Max HP from enemies through an ally, and deals pure damage to heal the ally chosen.
skill.lore: The strength of the living is simply borrowed from the strength of the dead.

skill.name: Plague Ward
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Summons a plague ward in a nearby vacant square to attack enemy units. The ward is immune to spell damage. Attacks of the wards reduce the attack rate of the target by 0.3.
skill.lore: A mixture of his old herbalist talents and newfound toxic mastery creates a living embodiment of plague.

skill.name: Viper Strike
skill.header: Targeted active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Viper Strike targets an enemy piece with the highest attack damage, reducing its attack speed and dealing ongoing poison. The victim also takes extra damage on hit.magic damage. Attack speed gradually recovers during the poison’s duration.
skill.lore: Once used to slay his sadistic summoner, the most powerful of Netherdrake infections spreads through the veins of those foolish enough to cross Viper.

skill.name: Chemical Rage
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and regenerations. Upon transformation, Alchemist sprays acidic chemicals around him, reducing the armor of nearby enemy pieces.
skill.lore: The brew Razzil gave to the Ogre during their prison bust has become a useful potion in the midst of combat.

skill.name: Mana break
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
Each attack will drain the mana of the target enemy chess piece, dealing additional physical damage equal to the mana drained..

Active ability: Activates when conditions are met.
Whenever a certain amount of mana is drained cumulatively, Anti-Mage will activate the Mana Void, target with a lower mana enemy, and deal magical damage based on the mana lost by the target together with a brief stun to enemies within range.
skill.lore: A martial technique, refined from the gentle techniques of the monks of the Starry Temple, capable of turning magical energy against its wielder.
notes: Anti-Mage will prioritize attacking targets with mana.

values.label: Triggers upon reaching the required cumulative damage

skill.name: Silken Bola
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description: The Broodmother will often entangle the nearest target, making it unable to move and causing attacks to miss. The target will suffer additional magical damage when attacked. If the target dies, a small spider will hatch.
skill.lore: She continues to raise her young, amidst the field of combat. The brood quickly learns how to support their mother.

skill.name: Holy Persuasion
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Resurrect the highest-level chess piece that died this round and increase its star level to the same level as the Holy Persuasion.
skill.lore: Although they may not be priests, Chen incorporates the fallen ones into the Temple in the same way he himself was converted.
notes: Allies, enemies and neutral creeps can all be persuaded.
Chen will not cast Holy Persuasion if no chess piece has died so far.
The Persuaded chess piece has abandoned its former faith and thus will not possess any previous status effects or items.

skill.name: Exorcism
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy chess pieces. At the end of the spells duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt.

skill.name: Doom
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Inflicts a curse that prevents an enemy chess piece from casting spells or using items or being healed, while taking damage over time.
skill.lore: When a name is tolled from the bell of Vashundol, doom is sure to follow.
notes: Before cast on the higher level enemy

skill.name: Elder Dragon Form
skill.header: Active ability: Activate on full mana
skill.description:
Davion transforms into one of three powerful elder dragons, granting him new Dragon Breath powers.
LEVEL 1 Red Dragon: Attacks deal splash damage to all enemy units in a 2-square range.
LEVEL 2 Blue Dragon: Attacks slow movement speed and attack speed of enemy units in a 2-square range.
LEVEL 3 Black Dragon: Attacks additionally deal magic damage over time to enemy units in a 2-square range, equal to a percentage of their health.
skill.lore: The dormant dragon power springs forth from within Davion, combining the powers of a legendary knight with a legendary Eldwurm.
notes: Each LEVEL of Elder Dragon Form grants effects from preceeding LEVELs.

skill.name: Rolling Boulder
skill.description:
Earth Spirit calls upon boulders from the surrounding to roll across the chessboard, striking and stunning all enemies in a row or column.
Killing blows immediately reset this ability.
skill.lore: It is with the power of a mountain that Earth Spirit strikes his enemies.

skill.name: Earth Splitter
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, stunning while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.
skill.lore: That which he created, the titan tears asunder.

skill.name: Sleight of Fist
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description:
Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location. Each attack deals bonus physical damage.
Killing an enemy chess piece instantly resets the cooldown of Sleight of Fist.
skill.lore: The studied warrior must whip and weave through its enemies, burning each without pause.
notes: Attack modifiers (such as critical strike, bash, cleave, chain lighting) can proc during Sleight of Fist.

skill.name: Illuminate
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Channels light energy, building power the longer its channeled. Once released or interrupted, a wave is sent forth in 3-grid width, dealing massive magical damage.
skill.lore: Ezalors hidden light reveals itself in marvelous fashion.

skill.name: Ghostship
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.
skill.lore: The final ship of the Claddish Navy is nothing but a phantom, but it is all too real to the enemies of the Admiral.

skill.name: Chain Frost
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units, slowing and dealing magical damage each time it hits.
skill.lore: Almost universally considered the ultimate in frost magic, Ethreains orb of frozen death strikes fear into those who dare stand against him.

skill.name: Finger of Death
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Tear into an enemy, inflicting a substantial amount of pure damage. For each stack of the Fel Power effect, it will deal additional pure damage
skill.lore: Lions disfigured hand is also the source of his greatest power, capable of flooding victims with malefic force.

values.label: Damage per Stack of Fel Power

skill.name: Summon Spirit Bear
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion in a nearby vacant square to battle for Lone Druid.
skill.lore: Syllas lifelong companion is symbiotic with his spirit and heart, coming to aid him in any time of need.

skill.name: Reverse Polarity
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Magnus changes the property of matter, sucking all enemies to him and stunning them with a powerful slam and dealing damage.
skill.lore: Magnus fights with the fury of the erupting Mt. Joerlak.

skill.name: Stone Gaze
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
The normal attack can always be split into multiple arrows to attack multiple target enemies.

Active ability: Activate when full mana
Any enemy pieces staring at Medusa will be Stone Gazed. The victims will suffer extra pure damage once based on its max health on gaze start.
skill.lore: The beauty of Medusa is legendary.
notes: Only attacks on the original target affected by Hunter - Aimed Shot.

skill.name: Jingu Mastery
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description: Always sensitive to the moods of its master, the Jingu Bang radiates power when Monkey Kings combat fervor is on full display. Monkey Kings attacks awaken the Jingu Bangs power. Upon the fourth hit of his attack, Monkey King unleashesBoundless Strike, causes critical damage and stun based on normal attacks to enemy pieces in a straight line.
skill.lore: Always sensitive to the moods of its master, the Jingu Bang radiates power when Sun Wukongs combat fervor is on full display.
notes: For every enemy struck by Boundless Strike, Monkey King instantly gains 1 stack of Jingu Mastery.

skill.name: Spiked Carapace
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Nyx Assassin takes his defensive form, reflects and negates damage dealt to him (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage.
skill.lore: While their carapaces are relatively thin, they're guarded by a retractable field of razor-sharp spikes.

skill.name: Swashbuckle
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Pangolier dashes along a target line, then slashes all enemies in the direction with several quick swipes, dealing attack damage.
skill.lore: The Pangoliers blade is even nimbler than his tongue.
notes: Immune to all damage when rolling.

skill.name: Coup de Grace
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, gaining a chance of delivering a devastating critical strike to enemy units and evading Ability Damage.
skill.lore: A divine strike, Mortred honors her opponent by choosing them for death.

skill.name: Sun Ray
skill.header: Active Ability: Activate Instant
skill.description: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
skill.lore: The vent through which such stellar energy flows is mere atoms wide.

skill.name: Lil' Shredder
skill.header: Active ability: Activate on full mana
skill.description: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire attacks that deal physical damage equal to her attack damage per hit. Each attack slows the enemys attack speed and reduces enemys armor, effect stackable.
skill.lore: Beadie constantly tinkers with a design she first dreamed up plotting an exodus from her old gang.

skill.name: Ball Lightning
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description:
Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield, dealing magical damage to enemies in the path. The damage is increased per 100 distance traveled.
Killing an enemy chess piece instantly resets the cooldown of Ball Lightning.
skill.lore: The Storm is coming in.

skill.name: Astral Step
skill.header: Active: Activate on full mana
skill.description: Void Spirit tears a rift, attacking several unmarked enemies successively along the path, giving each of them a void mark to slow down and detonate withmagical damage after a short delay. Killing an enemy chess piece instantly resets the cooldown of Astral Step.
skill.lore: A tiny step of Inai detonates devastatingly.

skill.name: au_portal
skill.lore: They come without warning, leaving fire and blood where kingdoms once flourished.

skill.name: Tempest Double
skill.header: Battle Cry Ability: Activates before the battle starts
skill.description: Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden creates a perfect electrical duplication of itself.
skill.lore: Warped by the power of its peers, Arc Warden becomes what it despises most: disharmony.
notes: The duplicate gains all benefits from Arc Wardens current items, but cannot duplicate again.

skill.name: Static Storm
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy chess pieces in the area for the duration. The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
skill.lore: A summer squall in Druud is a hardship that only an Oglodi can survive.

skill.name: Flak Cannon
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
The secondary cannon on the side of the Gyrocopter will continuously attack the furthest enemy piece.

Active ability: Activate immediately
The attack of the main artillery will simultaneously shoot all enemy pieces within the attack range that are not close, and continue to attack for several times.
skill.lore: The newly revamped Gyrocopter has attached enough armaments to assault in a 360 degree radius!

skill.name: Invoke
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
Summons three random elemental essences and fuses them into an invocation spell for the supplicant to cast. Each time the skill is cast, three random elemental essences are re-summoned and merged into another invocation spell.

Invocation Spell List
E.M.P.,Forge Spirit,Alacrity,Deafening Blast,Sun Strike,Chaos Meteor,Ice Wall
skill.lore: So begins a new age of knowledge.
notes: Invoker reinvokes at the beginning of each round of battle.

skill.name: Tether
skill.header: Battlecry Ability: Activates before the battle starts
skill.description: IO tethers with allies around, granting percentage damage reduction. Health percentage will be distributed equally among all tethered allies at set intervals.
skill.lore: The benevolent touch of Io brings strength from between the planes.
notes: Tether will break when IO dies or is too far from its ally.
Health from redistribution of tether will not be counted as Heal.

skill.name: Macropyre
skill.description: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire. Switches to Ice Path after cast.
skill.lore: Ice and fire combine to rip the battlefield to shreds with extreme temperatures.
notes: Macropyre destroys trees within the path upon cast.
Enemies caught by the flame will inflict burn damage for an extra 2 sec after leaving the area.

skill.name: Pulse Nova
skill.header: Active ability: Activates at full mana
skill.description: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, to damage nearby enemy units.Magic damageDrains Leshrac’s mana with each pulse.
skill.lore: If necessary, the Tormented Soul can manipulate space-time, ravaging lesser beings.

skill.name: Waveform
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
Morphling will transfer his properties between his attack damage and health percentage due to his health status. The higher his health percentage is, the higher the attack speed he gains.

Active Ability: Activates on accumulated attack times
Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges towards an far-away enemy, dealing magical damage to enemy units on his path.
skill.lore: A torrential flood takes enemies by force.

skill.name: Reapers Scythe
skill.header: Targeted Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Deals (base + percentage of max health) pure damage to an enemy with his Reaper’s Scythe and prevents its victim from deathrattle. And emits an aura that stops the heartbeat of his enemies around, dealing percentage damage based on their max health.
skill.lore: The amount of death and suffering in the air increases the power of the Necrophoss plague magic.
notes: The Reaper will prioritize favoring enemy chess pieces that can be directly killed.

skill.name: Guardian Angel
skill.header: Active ability: Activated on ally injured
skill.description: Summons a Guardian Angel that grants nearby allied pieces a Divine Protection Shield, gains an instant heal and significantly reduces physical and magic damage, and dispels negative effects.
skill.lore: The All-Seeing One casts down his protection over those that Purist calls friends.

skill.name: Pulverize
skill.header: Active Targeted ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing a nearby victim with highest HP and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and ministunning any enemy caught in the AoE.

skill.name: Sonic Wave
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy pure damage to all enemy units in its wake and disorienting the victims
skill.lore: Her most exquisite of all of the torments, Akashas Sonic Wave puts her poor foes out of their misery.
notes: Disorient: the affected piece loses control and wanders blindly.

skill.name: Spotlight
skill.header: Active Ability: Instant
skill.description: Ringmaster shines a spotlight that sweeps an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Non-permanent pieces and illusion pieces hit by the beam will fade away, by taking a Pure damage equal to a percentage of their health each second.
skill.lore: Are you ready for your fifteen seconds? The limelight draws no distintion between infamy and fame.

skill.name: Haunt
skill.header: Active ability: Activate on full mana
skill.description: Creates a spectral nemesis behind every enemy chess piece to attack them. Spectre and her haunts always attack with Desolate effect to targets that do not have allies around them.
skill.lore: At the height of combat, Mercurials physical manifestation shatters, and the shadowy pieces haunt those who still cling to life.
notes: No huant will be created if the square behind the enemy target is occupied.

skill.name: God's Strength
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
Svens regular attacks always cause 50% splash damage.

Active ability: Activates at Full Mana
The Wanderer Swordsman becomes formidable, receiving a significant increase in attack power. Additionally, all allied chess pieces with the power of Fel Energy experience a substantial boost in their attack power.
skill.lore: With the strength that shattered the Sacred Helm, the Rogue Knight stands unopposed in melee combat.
notes: The bonus damage is based on the base damage of the pieces.

values.label: damage bonus% per allied demon with Fel Power

skill.name: Explosive Bomb
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Plant an explosive that automatically detonates after a brief delay, dealing massive physical damage to enemies within a range of 4-grid radius.
skill.lore: The downfall of Dredgers Bight!

skill.name: Refraction
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
The normal attack of the Templar Assassin always has the effect of Psychic Blade. The attack can penetrate the enemy and cause Pure damage to the enemy pieces directly behind it..

Active ability: Activate when full mana
The Templar Assassin becomes very elusive, gaining an attack power bonus while avoiding damage.
The attack power bonus and damage avoidance effects are independent of each other, and they are both effects that can only be used a certain number of times.
skill.lore: Manipulating her psionic veil, Lanaya bends natures law to her will.

skill.name: Ravage
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemies within a 6-grid maximum range.
skill.lore: Calling to the abyssal god Maelrawn has resulted in entire armadas being lost at sea.

skill.name: Berserker's Rage
skill.header: Passive Ability
skill.description:
Each time the Troll Warlord hits an attack, there is a probability of launching Whirling Axes(Melee) or based on the distance from the target. Whirling Axes(remote), causing physical damage with 1 normal attack, and slow or blinding effect.
When the Troll Warlord switches attack targets, he must launch a whirlwind axe.
skill.lore: Like his anger, Troll Warlords supply of axes is infinite.
notes: Whirling Axes have individual cooldowns.

skill.name: Chaotic Offering
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Summons a Golem from the depths, dealing random stuns and random pure damage to enemies hit. The Golem has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack. After 3 seconds there may come another Golem.
skill.lore: Demnok unleashes the captive spirit in his Dreadwood staff, causing destruction in enemy ranks.
notes: Inferno Golems are devastating.

skill.name: Reincarnation
skill.header: Aura
skill.description: Grants deathrattle to all nearby allies whose level is no more than Wraith King: Reincarnation once directly on death.
skill.lore: Conspirators against the Wraith King wonder why he never stays dead.
notes: Non-permanent pieces cannot reincarnate. And pieces after reincarnation will be non-permanent pieces.

skill.name: Thundergods Wrath
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on full mana
skill.description:
Strikes all enemies on the chessboard standing on the squares of the same color as Zeus stands on, with a bolt of lightning that deals magical damage plus additional magical damage based on the remaining health of the victim.
Zeus additionally deals Thunder damage based on the current Courier health to enemy Courier after winning a visiting battle while standing to the last.
skill.lore: The Lord of Heaven smites all who oppose him, near or far.
notes: Chessboards are divided into black and white squares. "Same color" means Zeus and enemy both stand on black or white squares.
Additional Courier damage does not stack. If multiple Zeus pieces stayed alive through a winning visiting battle, only the highest additional damage will be applied.

skill.name: Primal Split
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 4 specialized elemental Pandaren warriors of the same Rank to battle for allie.
skill.lore: It isn't clear whether Mangix is consciously aware of his potent bond with nature, as it often occurs in the midst of a drunken stupor.
notes: Brewmaster no longer stays on chessboard after casting Primal Split.

skill.name: Phantasm
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions.
skill.lore: Drawing on his battles fought across many worlds and many times, phantasms of the Chaos Knight rise up to quell all who oppose him.

skill.name: Ice and Fire
skill.header: Active: Activate on full mana
skill.description: Jakiro casts ice and fire spells successively on enemies, Ice spell slows down enemies and fire spell hurts enemies.

skill.name: Mass Serpent Ward
skill.header: Active ability: Activates on Full Mana
skill.description: Summons Serpent Wards on every vacant square around the target to attck the enemies.
skill.lore: Snake charming was a big part of the Shadow Shamans act; now Rhasta can empower the Snakes to do his bidding.
